description: This Java source file defines a mock factory class for creating and simulating MQTT clients using HiveMQ in a testing context. It includes setup for mocked MQTT client behavior such as connecting, disconnecting, subscribing, and publishing messages, mainly for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: MockHiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: A mock implementation of HiveMqtt3ClientFactory for testing MQTT client interactions with HiveMQ.

methods.name: withException
methods.description: Sets an exception to be thrown during connection attempts, for simulating connection failures.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Adds a specific MQTT publish message to the mock client's message queue for a given topic.

methods.name: withMessages
methods.description: Adds multiple MQTT publish messages to the mock client's message queue.

methods.name: withTestProbe
methods.description: Associates an ActorRef probe to observe MQTT publish messages during testing.

methods.name: withFailingSubscribe
methods.description: Configures the mock client to simulate a subscription failure.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect() was called on all mock clients, used in test assertions.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a mock MQTT async client, including connection, disconnection, subscription, and publishing behaviors.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mocked Mqtt3ClientBuilder that supplies the mocked MQTT client when built.
